objective: Selecting Palma produces a finite daily briefing across weather, relevant transport notices, same-day cultural events and recent municipal announcements, each attributable and time-bounded.

acceptance.K1: Fixed reviewed source URLs and explicit city identity; other cities retain their existing coverage.
acceptance.T1: Reject wrong sources, unsupported source formats, forbidden robots paths, redirections, oversized data and unsupported dates. Source outages and unconnected domains remain distinct from zero matching records.
acceptance.T2: Use the Europe/Madrid day and explicit event times; past event starts and expired transport intervals never appear as currently actionable. Municipal publication is not an effective date or independent confirmation.
acceptance.A1: City selection alone includes local coverage, including in personal briefing with no topic selection. Relevant source links and concrete next steps appear in cards.
acceptance.A2: Essential, discovery and administrative context remain finite; unchanged old topic flow, browser-only consent and saved comparison validation are preserved.
acceptance.V1: Strict TypeScript, existing full suite, new failure and temporal tests, live-source acquisition, browser flow at mobile/desktop widths, independent diff review.
acceptance.R1: No payment/account activation, new paid data source, background jobs, CSS or branding changes.

bounds.release: only same verified candidate; no forced deployment
